name: Almaraz de Duero (Spain)
description: Square flag of four horizontal stripes of crimson red, green, white and crimson red.
history: The town council of Almaraz de Duero, by resolution of 2 December 2010, approved the municipal arms and flag; the flag is square, of dimensions 1:1, with four horizontal stripes which from top to bottom are crimson red, green, white and crimson red, with the arms at the centre between the green and white stripes.
